title: 3.3.9c Lab — Loop: mutate a property
description: Loop over the planets array in setup() and set each planet's shape.color to a different value.

steps.title: Loop and set shape.color on each planet
steps.instructions: In setup(), write a loop over the planets array that sets each planet's `.shape.color` to a value from a color array. For example: `const colors = ['deepskyblue','gold','tomato']; for (let i = 0; i < planets.length; i++) { planets[i].shape.color = colors[i]; }`
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right and look up the color property on shapes.

requirements.title: Loop assigns shape.color to each planet
requirements.description: Write a loop in setup() that sets .shape.color on each planet in the array.

requirements.title: A loop structure iterates over planets
requirements.description: Use a for loop or for...of loop to iterate over the planets array.
